name: Unicorn Story: Perspective Specialization Guide
description: Supplement to the main cognitive_framework.json, detailing how specific perspectives manifest in the Unicorn story. Shows transformation of perspectives in skeptical self-preservation context.

primary_explicit.name: paradoxní
primary_explicit.why_key: Central paradox of being whose existence depends on denying its origin
manifestations: Být reálný by znamenalo přestat být jednorožcem
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer G (ENTITY) rather than base layer I (TIME) - paradox becomes about being itself, not just time

primary_explicit.name: filozofický
primary_explicit.why_key: Raises questions about reality, identity, and the nature of existence
manifestations: Může být něco reálné a přesto mýtické?
Kdo jsem, když popírám svůj původ?
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer A (X) rather than base layer C (PHENOMENON) - philosophical questions become the unknown variable

primary_explicit.name: meta
primary_explicit.why_key: Story comments on the nature of belief, denial, and storytelling itself
manifestations: Reflexe o tom, jak vznikají mýty
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer L (SYMBOL) rather than base layer A (X) - meta-reflection becomes cultural symbol

secondary_implicit.name: absurdní
secondary_implicit.why_key: Absurdity of hybrid creature and its logical acrobatics

secondary_implicit.name: metaforický
secondary_implicit.why_key: Rich metaphors throughout (odraz se stínem, ploutev se srstí)

secondary_implicit.name: psychologický
secondary_implicit.why_key: Psychological state of panic when discovering origin, then systematic denial

tertiary_present.name: kulturní
tertiary_present.why_key: Archetype of unicorn as mythical being

tertiary_present.name: asociativní
tertiary_present.why_key: Free associations between ploutev, srst, roh, stín, odraz

tertiary_present.name: ironický
tertiary_present.why_key: Irony that disbelief in reality preserves the magical

layer_transformations_specific_to_unicor.transformation_description: Paradox moves from temporal dimension to become about being itself. It's not about when, but about what one is.
layer_transformations_specific_to_unicor.story_evidence: Paradox není v čase, ale v samotné existenci – být reálný by znamenalo nebýt jednorožcem

layer_transformations_specific_to_unicor.transformation_description: Philosophical questions move from being about phenomena to becoming the unknown framework. The question of reality becomes the story's very structure.
layer_transformations_specific_to_unicor.story_evidence: Celý příběh je otázkou 'co je reálné?' – tato otázka je rámcem, ne obsahem

layer_transformations_specific_to_unicor.transformation_description: Meta-reflection moves from unknown variable to become cultural symbol. Thinking about storytelling becomes itself a myth.
layer_transformations_specific_to_unicor.story_evidence: Závěrečné ponaučení o zachraňování jednorožce se stává kulturním symbolem, moudrostí

perspective_interactions_unique_to_unico.description: Tension between paradox (existence through denial) and philosophy (questions about reality). Paradox provides the phenomenon, philosophy asks the questions.
perspective_interactions_unique_to_unico.manifestation: Že popření umožňuje bytí je paradox; že se ptáme 'co to znamená být' je filosofie

perspective_interactions_unique_to_unico.description: Absurdity of hybrid creature is expressed through metaphors. Nespojitelné se spojuje v metaforách (ploutev se srstí).
perspective_interactions_unique_to_unico.manifestation: Absurdita potřebuje metafory, aby se dala vyjádřit

perspective_interactions_unique_to_unico.description: Meta-reflection on denial meets psychological experience of panic. Přemýšlení o popření a prožívání popření současně.
perspective_interactions_unique_to_unico.manifestation: Jednorožcovo rozhodnutí zapřít je psychologické, ale příběh o tom je meta-komentář

horn_and_star.description: Roh a hvězda – metaforické (symbol jednorožce), kulturní (archetyp), asociativní (spojení s magií)

woman_in_water.description: Žena ve vodě – psychologický (její výraz), filozofický (možnost odrazu), meta (může být vypravěčka)

denial_text.description: Text 'nevěřím' – meta (komentář), paradoxní (popření uprostřed obrazu jednorožce), absurdní

water_surface.description: Vodní hladina – metaforická (zrcadlo), filozofická (pravda), asociativní (spojení s delfíny)

ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.i_paradoxical: Can AI accept circular logic where denial enables existence? Can it work with hybrid origins?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.c_philosophical: Can AI engage with questions about reality without demanding single answer?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.a_meta: Can AI understand that the story comments on belief and storytelling itself?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.layer_transformations: Can AI detect how perspectives shift layers in skeptical context?

with_worm.contrast: Worm: identity fragments and multiplies; Unicorn: identity depends on denying origin

with_bat.contrast: Bat: truth context-dependent; Unicorn: existence context-dependent

with_fox.contrast: Fox: essence after loss; Unicorn: essence through denial

with_lemur.contrast: Lemur: paradox of being seen; Unicorn: paradox of being real

note: This guide supplements but does not replace cognitive_framework.json. It shows how the universal perspectives manifest specifically in the Unicorn story's context of skeptical self-preservation and origin denial.
